permissions: local preservation and bounded non-commercial research use
public bibliographic metadata, stable identifiers, and provenance may remain tracked
MDZ declares the exact digital object CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and exposes IIIF image services and an immediate PDF route
restrictions: reuse is non-commercial and requires attribution and ShareAlike under the provider-declared license
the operator-held PDF remains local and is never uploaded to the future site
holding-copy images, MDZ-generated PDF, underlying text, any OCR, and later derivatives remain separately reviewable
future public use must preserve holding institution, call number, page or leaf number, URN, license notice, and any other provider attribution requirements
any future public payload requires a separate current route, conditions check, human rights review, and explicit operator approval
rationale: The exact MDZ manifest supplies a concrete CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license claim and the provider documents immediate research download routes. ToS preserves that positive evidence but does not convert an unreviewed model assessment into payload publication authorization.
